themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers the use of AI agents that can autonomously perform tasks and make decisions within research workflows, often involving complex sequences of actions.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, including specific mentions of models like Claude Code and GPT-4.1.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist in various stages of research, from discovery to analysis and reporting.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that directly support design processes, from ideation and prototyping to UI generation and design system application.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications specifically designed to create, distribute, analyze, and optimize surveys, enhancing data collection and insights.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to generate various forms of content, including text, images, and potentially code, for research and design purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to condense large amounts of text, research papers, or meeting transcripts into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Explores AI's application in analyzing and extracting insights from qualitative data, such as interview transcripts and open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's impact on the job market, including AI's role in replacing jobs, creating new ones, and influencing hiring processes.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency, and identifying bugs.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
